R1_terminal_outcome: 1 for terminal task predicate success; 0 otherwise
R2_contact_preservation: 1 - EXP11 H20 coarse-regime change fraction relative to the successful reference

R3_motion_goal.drawer: projection of terminal middle-drawer body displacement onto the successful reference displacement, normalized by reference terminal displacement
R3_motion_goal.stove: terminal button rotation from initial, normalized by the successful reference terminal rotation
R3_motion_goal.bowl: one minus terminal bowl-to-plate planar distance normalized by the initial distance

catastrophic: terminal failure OR R2 < 0.5 OR R3 < 0
note: R2 is a successful-reference preservation proxy; it is not equivalent to universal contact safety. R4 is evaluation-only ground truth.
